_comment: Shrink-only self-tree validation ratchet baseline (WI-jigup). Per-(validator_class|severity) ceiling for `hypergumbo run .` on this repo, enforced by the full-suite self-tree-validation job via scripts/check-self-tree-validation. A cell may shrink below its ceiling (ratchet it DOWN here when it does) but never grow; an unbaselined cell has ceiling 0. ADR-0036 Ruling 2 (WI-pubiv) drove id_format|warning 3012 -> 46 by rebuilding external boundary-node ids with a pure external_symbol kind-slot (the use-site reference syntax moved to meta.reference_syntax); the residual 46 is the route/event, npm_package, and tsconfig kind-slot cohorts from other producers (WI-kugaj/WI-zugob + fast-follows). A pre-existing id_format|error:1 (Maven-dependency name-slot colon, a Ruling-1 follow-up) and cross_field|info:6 are separate and remain unbaselined. Measured 2026-07-02 on default flags, 38417 symbols.
